info.name: Allegro, the Master of the Rings

descriptions.notStarted: Romeo had decided to propose to Juliet. To help fascilitate that, I better get him a nice ring. The ring can be acquired through Allegro, the master of rings at Wedding Village.
descriptions.inProgress:
Allegro said the perfect ring for Romeo and Juliet might be the Silver Wing Ring that represents purity, and asked me to gather up the materials for him.
